description: This file defines a GoalsFragment class in an Android application, which presents a dialog to edit fitness goals with input validation. It interacts with a MockRepository to get and update profile goals, uses view binding, and displays toast messages upon saving.

classes.name: GoalsFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment allowing users to edit their fitness goals with validation and default handling, utilizing view binding and repository interactions.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a dialog for editing fitness goals, initializing input fields with current values, handling save/cancel actions with validation and updating the repository.
